name: Panasonic Energy Kansas Factory
operator: Panasonic Energy Corporation of North America

sources.evidence: Panasonic Energy's July 14, 2025 official release identifies the Kansas Factory of Panasonic Energy Corporation of North America at 10301 Astra Parkway, De Soto, Kansas, states that the factory opened in July 2025, and confirms mass production of automotive cylindrical lithium-ion 2170 cells.
Panasonic's current global locations page identifies the Kashiwara location at 13-13 Katayama-cho, Kashiwara-shi, Osaka as Panasonic Cycle Technology Co., Ltd.

Panasonic Cycle Technology's current company profile identifies the same Kashiwara address as its headquarters and states that its business includes manufacturing and selling conventional bicycles, electric-assist bicycles and tricycles, electric units, and repair parts.
